hints.title: Digit DP on Strings with Evil Pattern Automaton
hints.text: Count strings of length n lexicographically bounded by s1 and s2 that do not contain evil as a substring.

hints.title: KMP Failure Function for Evil Matching
hints.text: Build prefix function for evil. As digits are placed, advance through the prefix automaton. A transition reaching len(evil) is invalid.

hints.title: Digit DP State Memoization Blueprint
hints.text: State is (idx, evil_match_idx, is_less_s1, is_greater_s2). Iterate allowed characters bounded by s1[idx] and s2[idx].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: State space is bounded by N positions times M evil automaton states times 4 boolean limit flags.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 26^N candidate strings and executing substring searches causes exponential blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: KMP state transitions enable instant O(1) state descent without backtracking string history.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Digit dynamic programming integrated with KMP pattern matching automaton.
